name: Monster picker text
notes: Shown once the logo has landed: this monster's best time (its fastest won run) above it, under the logo — BEST TIME --:-- until it wins a run — arrows on both sides of the monster, its name and type centered under it, then a blinking PRESS START and, at the bottom, the SELECT: CLEAR SAVE hint. Browsing to another monster switches the best time to that monster's. On a locked monster the two bottom lines become a blinking LOCKED and WIN WITH A NEW MONSTER (they follow 'sel_locked', which the picker sets): only the first win of a monster that never won a run (BEST TIME --:--) unlocks the next one.

elements.text: {sel_locked|SELECT: CLEAR SAVE|WIN WITH A NEW MONSTER}
